item.title: Prayer for 1 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for everyone who is looking forward to - or worried about - what 2026 may bring. God, walk with us all. Amen.

item.title: Prayer for 2 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for the discussions between Ukraine, Russia, and other world governments that a lasting peace may be secured.

item.title: Prayer for 3 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for compassion and understanding of others in our multi-cultural society.

item.title: Prayer for 4 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for Heather and Phil as Heather retires and they embrace the next step in their lives together. We thank them for all they have done for St. James.

item.title: Prayer for 5 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for our local schools as they return for the new term.

item.title: Prayer for 6 January
item.description: Good morning everyone. Today we praying for our local care homes. Father God, please bless residents, visitors and all those involved in delivering care.

item.title: Prayer for 7 January
item.description: Lord God, as this day begins, draw us closer to you and guide us in all that we do. Amen.
